visibleEvidence.wordFrameDescription: From right to left: readable vav, fragmented but identifiable alef, an effectively blank third consonant frame, and readable final tav. The niqqud survives better than the damaged third consonant.

letters.evidence: Two vertically separated points under vav are clear in companion; original has matching joined vertical group.
Surviving diagonal/body fragments support alef. Three detached lower points form a segol triangle in both native crops; do not replace with expected patah.

letters.status: editorial reconstruction proposed; consonant not readable
letters.evidence: The consonant frame is lost; a distinct horizontal bar and central descending stem survive underneath, supporting qamats. Retain this visible point on the proposed restored het.
Roof, two descending sides and left foot identify final tav; no vowel is supplied.

editorialInference.reason: Visible ו/א/ת and the surviving qamats occupy the expected four-letter frame after מאה וחמשים. The Greek and Brenton date151 supports the numeral one, hence reconstruction of the missing het in ואחת. The missing letter itself remains inferred.
notAsserted: That the lost het is visible.
That another Hebrew witness verifies Kahana’s entire word.
That the unusual printed segol/qamats should be normalized to standard vocalization.
That the earlier provisional token וָז׳ was valid source text.
editorialInference.remainingUncertainty: Exact consonant identity in the missing frame requires an editorial decision; no new unrestricted same-edition copy has resolved it directly.

proposedChange.afterText: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־דֶּמֶטְרִיוֹס הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּשְׁנַת מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְאֶחָת וַיָּבֵא לוֹ עֲטֶרֶת זָהָב וְתֹמֶר וּמִלְּבַד אֵלֶּה עַנְפֵי זַיִת מִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וּבַיּוֹם הַהוּא הָיָה שָׁקֵט׃
proposedChange.readerNoteEnglish: The letter ח at position 3 in וְאֶחָת is an editorial restoration; it is unreadable in the source scan.
proposedChange.proposedReviewExplanation: The lost ח is restored from surviving ו/א/ת, the qamats below its frame, and the public-domain Greek/Brenton date 151. Visible vav sheva, alef segol and het-frame qamats are retained literally.
proposedChange.contractCompatibility: Existing restoredLetter/consonant note at exact index 3. No retainedVowels field; independently readable qamats remains attached to the restored consonant. No native UI/schema changes required.

independentCorroboration.scope: Viewed both new native crops independently; corroborated vav sheva, three separate segol dots, qamats below missing third consonant and final tav. Directed pinning proposal as וְאֶחָת with ח index3, without changing canonical.
independentCorroboration.approvalConsequence: This concurrence verifies the proposed evidence scope, not user approval of the restoration.

approvalNeeded.reason: Prior general permission covers isolated unreadable vowel marks; the WIS 1:16 lamed restoration was specific and does not authorize this new consonant restoration.
approvalNeeded.questionDraft: May we restore the missing ח in 2 Maccabees 14:4 as וְאֶחָת, retaining the visible printed vowel points and explicitly labeling ח as an editorial reconstruction? The surviving letters and Greek/Brenton year 151 support it; the letter itself is lost in both available scans.
